how: Captured live in the Claude desktop app's browser on the owner's laptop (the build sandbox cannot reach these hosts). Each script that ran is saved under scripts/capture/ or described below; results were copied byte-for-byte from the browser's JSON output (not retyped) and their totals were checked.

city_incidents_tiles.json.kept: counts per 0.01-degree tile in violent / property / enforcement buckets, per-city totals, match rates, and the offense-label-to-bucket table. No address, incident ID or officer name was kept.
city_incidents_tiles.json.checks: tile totals equal 'placed' counts: Norfolk 9,143 of 10,941 used incidents (84%), Charlottesville 2,243 of 2,614 (86%)

fbi_cde_agencies_2025_va.json.source: FBI Crime Data Explorer /LATEST/summarized/agency/{ORI}/{V|P}?from=01-2025&to=12-2025, agency list /LATEST/agency/byStateAbbr/VA
fbi_cde_agencies_2025_va.json.kept: 240 city, town and county agencies: 2025 violent and property offense sums, months reported, CDE population
fbi_cde_agencies_2025_va.json.checks: statewide sum 17,811 violent offenses (excluding State Police, campus agencies and Virginia Beach, which reported 0 months)

hud_fmr_fy2026_va.json.how: xlsx read in the browser (zip + XML, no library); Virginia rows only
hud_fmr_fy2026_va.json.kept: 133 rows: FIPS, county name, HUD area, metro flag, 2023 population, FMR 0-4 bedrooms

hud_hic_2025_va.json.kept: 16 Virginia CoCs: year-round, seasonal, overflow beds; beds for adults and for families

hud_coc_membership_va.json.how: one point-in-polygon query per locality interior point; see 'method' inside the file
hud_coc_membership_va.json.note: The layer's unsheltered counts have no year and sum above the 2025 statewide count, so they are kept for reference only and not used.

not_captured.PIT counts by CoC: HUD publishes 2007-2025-PIT-Counts-by-CoC only as .xlsb (binary), which the browser reader cannot parse; shelter uses beds per 10,000 residents instead.
not_captured.Virginia Beach incidents: Its ArcGIS incident layer now answers 'Token Required'.
not_captured.Virginia Beach FBI counts: VBPD reported 0 months of 2025 to the FBI CDE; shown as Unknown.
not_captured.Virginia State Police per-jurisdiction t: Crime in Virginia 2025 (PDF) has no per-locality tables; those are only on the VSP dashboard.
